display.note: Active area datasheet-verified 2026-07-15: 24.91 x 14.86 mm (same 1.14" glass as the Stick family, rotated; ~241 PPI); was 30.0 x 17.0 mm (~202 PPI). Origin photo-measured 2026-10-18: the glass's black window on the vendor front photo spans x 20.75-45.66, y 2.93-17.79 mm, the active area itself.

keyboard.notes: Geometry only: the 56 black push buttons as drawn on the front (2026-10-18). What is printed for each key (its legend, its shifted legend, an arrow, the colored block under some) is the front's, drawn in svg/front.svg by _shared/emit_front_svg.py from its own table, with a legend group and an hs-key-<slug> hotspot per key, and what each key types is the Kleidos firmware's (kKeyMap, src/hal/input/cardputer_key_decoder.h); neither is listed here a second time. The columns are 5.773 mm apart (gap_mm is the horizontal gap); row centers at y 26.98 / 34.44 / 41.93 / 49.41, each row under its white legend strip (y 21.55-25.45, 28.95-32.45, 36.25-39.8, 43.9-47.6).

notes: Cardputer ADV: white case with black base trim, TCA8418 + ES8311. The keys are plain black buttons; the color is in the legend blocks printed above some of them, as the front draws them: fn orange, Aa blue, opt green, tab, ctrl and alt gray.
